subject: CSA verification kickoff — control linkage, sampling windows, and live-replay artifacts

From: Eve Martinez <eve.martinez@cedarbank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit.team@cedarbank.com
Date: 2026-12-02T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: CSA verification kickoff and live artifact requests

Hi Grace and Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. CedarBank's compliance team is starting our CSA (CAIQ) verification for Q4 and we'd like to kick off the evidence and sampling work with Redwood.

High-level asks:
- A mapping of Redwood's CSA responses to control owners + evidence locations (we need to see where logs, attestation, and keystore proofs live).
- A 48–72 hour window where we can request runtime replay snippets / KV cache prefixes for a small set of test tenants (redacted as necessary).
- Proof of key rotation / KMS attestations for tenant-bound keys used in Private deployments.

Can you confirm owners, an initial timeline, and what artifacts you can provide this week? We prefer attachments or a Drive link rather than inline.

Eve Martinez
Manager, Cloud Compliance
CedarBank

Attachments: none
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Eve Martinez <eve.martinez@cedarbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CSA verification kickoff and live artifact requests

Eve — thanks for the clear ask. Internal owners below and a proposal for next steps.

Quick owner list:
- Control mapping & narrative: Kimberly Park (Controls & Evidence)
- Runtime replay / logs & KV cache samples: David Kim (Infra Observability)
- KMS / key rotation proofs: Grace O'Connor (Security Liaison)

Proposed timeline:
1) Today: send an initial mapping workbook + list of required control IDs (attached).
2) Thurs (48 hours): provide a redacted runtime excerpt + telemetry sample (we'll limit to a pre-agreed tenant set).
3) Friday: DocuSign request and final owner attestations.

I've attached an initial mapping draft for your review — it includes suggested evidence locations (Drive paths), owner emails, and whether we can provide a live-replay sample or a synthetic extract.

Action items for you: confirm the tenant IDs (pseudonyms ok), the control IDs you want prioritized (e.g., CSA-DEV-6, CSA-OPS-3), and whether your auditors need raw logs or hashed extracts.

We will gate any live replay on SLA and privacy redaction; David, can you confirm the size/format of the runtime excerpt you can generate?

Best,

Grace O'Connor
Applied ML — Observability & Evidence
Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial_csa_mapping_draft.xlsx
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Eve Martinez <eve.martinez@cedarbank.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T13:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CSA verification kickoff and live artifact requests

Grace / Kimberly / Eve — quick technical reply with what we can provide for the Thursday window.

What we can deliver (samples attached):
- kv_cache_runtime_excerpt.txt — 5k token prefix traces (redacted tenant IDs, timestamps preserved to show sequence).
- telemetry_sample.jsonl — a 24-hour telemetry slice with masked user identifiers and request hashes.

Notes / limitations:
- We will not provide PII. All tenant identifiers are pseudonymized per our intake policy.
- For replay, we can provide reconstructed token streams and model-call metadata but not raw model weights or full request payloads.
- If auditors need HSM/KMS logs, we can provide rotation attestations and signed KMS audit statements (certified by our KMS provider) — Grace will coordinate those.

Eve — I'll stage the artifacts to the Drive folder and share a time-limited access link once Grace confirms the tenant list. Attaching small excerpts here for immediate review.

—David
David Kim
SRE / Observability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kv_cache_runtime_excerpt.txt, telemetry_sample.jsonl
